 Voting Alert: The 10-Day Early Voting Period for the 2026 General Election Starts Thursday, October 22nd, ahead of the Tuesday, November 3rd Election Day 
 DOVER, DE – The Delaware Department of Elections (DOE) is issuing a voting alert informing Delaware registered voters that Early Voting for the 2026 General Election starts this Thursday, October 22, 2026. 
 General Election voters may vote at any Early Voting Site for their county of residence during the 10 day early voting period before General Election Day. Early voting hours are 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on the first 5 days of early voting and 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. on the last 5 days of early voting. 
 General Election Early Voting Sites and Schedule are listed below and at https://de.gov/evsites: 
 General Election Early Voting Dates & Times:
 October 22nd – October 24th, 7 a.m. – 7 p.m.
 October 25th – No Early Voting
 October 26th & October 27th, 7 a.m. – 7 p.m.
 October 28th – November 1st, 11 a.m. – 7 p.m.
 General Election Early Voting Sites:
 Kent County: (4 sites)
 BPOE #1903 Elks Lodge, 200 S. Saulsbury Rd., Dover, DE 19904
 Frederica Senior Center, 216 Market St., Frederica, DE 19946
 Harrington Parks & Recreation, 114 E. Liberty St., Harrington, DE 19952
 Wyoming United Methodist Church, 216 Wyoming Mill Rd., Dover, DE 19904
 New Castle County: (6 sites)
 Appoquinimink State Service Center, 122 Silver Lake Rd., Middletown, DE 19709
 Claymont Community Center, 3301 Green St., Claymont, DE 19703
 Department of Elections Warehouse – New Castle, 220 Lisa Dr., New Castle, DE 19720
 Hudson State Service Center, 501 Ogletown Rd., Newark, DE 19711
 The Delaware Contemporary, 200 S. Madison St., Wilmington, DE 19801
 Wilmington Police Athletic League (PAL), 3707 N. Market St., Wilmington, DE 19802
 Sussex County (9 sites)
 Department of Elections Warehouse – Georgetown, 542 S. Bedford St., Georgetown, DE 19947
 Department of Elections Warehouse – Seaford, 200 Allen St., Seaford, DE 19973 [ Access from Stein Hwy onto Dulaney Street ]
 Ellendale Fire Hall, 302 Main St., Ellendale, DE 19941
 Indian River Fire Company – Station #2, 25375 Banks Rd., Millsboro, DE 19966
 Laurel Fire Hall, 205 W. 10th St., Laurel, DE 19956
 Margaret Rollins Community Center, 101 Adams Ave., Lewes, DE 19958
 Millville Community Center, 32517 Dukes Dr., Millville, DE 19967
 Nassau Valley Vineyard, 32130 Winery Rd., Lewes, DE 19958
 Roxana Fire Hall, 35943 Zion Church Rd., Frankford, DE 19945
 Any Delaware resident who has registered to vote by the October 10th voter registration deadline may vote in the General Election regardless of political party affiliation. To check your registration, visit https://ivote.de.gov. 
 Early voting is nearly identical to voting on election day, except that voters may vote at any early voting site for their county of residence. On Election Day, November 3, 2026, voters must vote at their assigned polling place. 
 At the check-in table at an early voting site, voters may show one form of ID, which may any one of the following items: Delaware Driver’s License or State ID Card, or a Department of Elections polling place card or Department of Elections voter information mailer, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or other government document that shows their name and address. 
 If a voter does not present identification, election officers will verify their voter registration information. When their voter registration is confirmed, they will be permitted to vote after completing an Affidavit of Affirmation of Voter Identity. 
 More information about Delaware’s 2026 General Election is available at https://de.gov/gen. Voters may view their voter registration record at https://ivote.de.gov. To find a conveniently located early voting site, or their assigned polling place, voters may use the Department’s GIS Lookup Tool https://de.gov/voteplaces. 
 DOE Information 
 For more information, visit the Department of Elections website at elections.delaware.gov and connect with the Department on Facebook ,  X (formerly Twitter) , Instagram , and YouTube .

 At the check-in table at an early voting site, voters may show one form of ID, which may any one of the following items: Delaware Driver’s License or State ID Card, or a Department of Elections polling place card or Department of Elections voter information mailer, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or other government document that shows their name and address. 
 If a voter does not present identification, election officers will verify their voter registration information. When their voter registration is confirmed, they will be permitted to vote after completing an Affidavit of Affirmation of Voter Identity. 
 More information about Delaware’s 2026 General Election is available at https://de.gov/gen. Voters may view their voter registration record at https://ivote.de.gov. To find a conveniently located early voting site, or their assigned polling place, voters may use the Department’s GIS Lookup Tool https://de.gov/voteplaces. 
 DOE Information 
 For more information, visit the Department of Elections website at elections.delaware.gov and connect with the Department on Facebook ,  X (formerly Twitter) , Instagram , and YouTube .
